mapper.update: UPDATE batch_execution_log SET status = #{status}, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, duration_ms = #{durationMs}, records_processed = COALESCE(#{recordsProcessed}, records_processed), records_failed = COALESCE(#{recordsFailed}, records_failed), error_summary = #{errorSummary}, retry_count = COALESCE(#{retryCount}, retry_count) WHERE id = #{id}
